description: Variation of Conditions 2 (Approved plans), 4 (Vehicle Dismantling Area Door), 5 (Air Compressor Tools), 7 (Number of Vehicles), 8 (Process of Vehicles) and 11 (Parking, Vehicle Holding and Bicycle Parking Areas) of planning permission 01366/V/P1 dated 01/10/2018 for change of use from Class B2 to a use for the dismantling and recycling of end of life motor vehicles
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three
years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SP-0064.01 (Rev A), SP-0064.02 (Rev A), Planning Statement, Noise Assessment, Air Quality Assessment & Transport Report; received 29/06/2018; and SP-0064.04 (Rev C) received on 18 June 2019).) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Surface water draining from areas of hardstanding shall be passed through an oil interceptor or series of oil interceptors, prior to being discharged into any watercourse, soakaway or surface water sewer. The interceptor(s) shall be designed and constructed to have a capacity compatible with the area being drained, shall be installed prior to the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained throughout the lifetime of the development. Clean roof water shall not pass through the interceptor(s). Vehicle washdowns and detergents shall not be passed through the interceptor.

Condition : 4 - The external door serving the area marked 'Vehicle Dismantling Area' on drawing no. SP- 0064.04 Rev C : Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans shall remain fully closed at all times during vehicle dismantling operations taking place within the area identified as the 'Vehicle Dismantling Area'.

Condition : 5 - The only mechanical equipment to be used within the area marked 'Vehicle Dismantling Area' on drawing no. SP-0064.04 Rev C : Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans shall be air compressor tools unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No activity or operation shall take place at the site other than between the hours of 08.00 and 18.00 Mondays to Fridays inclusive and between the hours of 09.00 and 13.00 on Saturdays and at no time on Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays except for works of essential maintenance or which are to respond to an emergency, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - A maximum of three end of life vehicles at any one time may be parked within the defined Vehicle Holding Area identified within the 'Yard' on drawing no. SP-0064.04 Rev C : Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans.

Condition : 8 - No end of life vehicles or any other vehicles used for the dismantling of parts or repairs shall be treated or processed in any way except within the building defined on drawing no. SP- 0064.04 Rev C : Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans.

Condition : 9 - No development shall be occupied until full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than five bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 10 - No part of the development shall be occupied until full details of electric vehicle parking provision has been provided in accordance with details that have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform with requirements stipulated within the London Plan and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 11 - The parking, vehicle holding and bicycle parking areas shown on the drawing no. SP- 0064.04 Rev C: Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans shall be implemented prior to commencement of the use hereby approved and shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.
